messages:
Aisha: FYI I ran a bring-up eval for rerank-lite-4b int8 (symmetric quant) against holdout-mix-2026-04. NDCG_all down 1.9 pts, but longtail (>800 tokens) shows a 2.7 pt drop. MRR ~flat.

Tom: ouch. can you paste the exact run args and runtime flags?

Aisha: command: 
```
./run_eval.sh --model rerank-lite-4b --weights quant/sym-8b.ckpt --holdout holdout-mix-2026-04 --seed 7 --batch 128 --report ndcg,mrr --slice longtail
```
runtime flags: pack_kv=auto, align_kv=on, per_channel=true, quant_scheme=symmetric

Leo: pack_kv=auto recently got a heuristic: it flips to true when avg_seq_len > 512 to save memory. Could be interacting with symmetric scaling.

EvalBot: summary: run=6180023456 model=rerank-lite-4b-int8-symmetric ndcg_all=0.642 ndcg_long=0.558 mrr_all=0.413 seed=7 duration=1h12m

Maya: what's the fp32 baseline on the same slice?

Aisha: fp32 baseline -> ndcg_all=0.661 ndcg_long=0.585 mrr_all=0.415

Tom: so longtail delta = -0.027 absolute (~4.6% relative). Not trivial. First quick checks: 1) candidate pool parity, 2) tokenizer and padding parity, 3) deterministic RNG/seed.

Aisha: candidate diffs check:
```
python -c "from harness import load_candidates; a=load_candidates('holdout-mix-2026-04','fp32'); b=load_candidates('holdout-mix-2026-04','int8'); print('diff', len(set(a.ids)-set(b.ids)))"
```
-> diff 0

Leo: tokenizer/padding? longtail may have been truncated differently under the int8 runtime if runtime enabled some eager chunking for pack_kv. Compare token lengths per doc for top 200 queries.

Aisha: ran token length hist diff on the longtail subset: small shift at tail where ~2% of docs were clipped by 1-3 tokens due to align_kv behavior.

Maya: that aligns with pack and align heuristics. Even tiny truncation at end of doc can shift context for reranker and change scores. For NDCG even small swaps across many queries add up.

Tom: try two ablations: 1) pack_kv=false + align_kv=off; 2) per_channel=false (per_tensor). Keep seed. If pack_kv is the trigger we should see recovery.

EvalBot: run-started: 6180023460 variant=pack_off

EvalBot: run-started: 6180023462 variant=per_tensor

Aisha: quick result: pack_off -> ndcg_all=0.655 ndcg_long=0.579 mrr_all=0.414; per_tensor -> ndcg_all=0.649 ndcg_long=0.572 mrr_all=0.414

Leo: pack_off recovers most of the gap. per_tensor helps but not as much. So it's the packing+alignment heuristics affecting truncation/ordering.

Maya: can you paste an example diff for a longtail query where we see rank swap?

Aisha: example:
```
query_id: LQ998
fp32_top5: [D3, D11, D27, D59, D102]
int8_auto_top5: [D3, D27, D11, D59, D102]
scores_fp32: [0.92,0.87,0.86,0.82,0.78]
scores_int8: [0.92,0.86,0.87,0.82,0.78]
```
small swap between D11 and D27 repeatedly across ~150 queries.

Tom: consistent pattern. Actionable items: 1) update the onboarding checklist to pin pack_kv for initial quant comparisons, 2) add a smoke test that computes token-length parity and candidate set parity before scoring, 3) document runtime heuristics that mutate inputs (align_kv, pack_kv) so SRE/devs can opt out during evals.

Leo: I'll open a PR to add a runtime flag --eval-mode which forces all heuristics off and guarantees token/candidate parity with baseline.

Maya: can infra add a CI gate that runs quick token-length parity on random 500 queries when a new quant config is submitted?

EvalBot: note: created issue RNW-1823 for KV-pack parity test. created gist of attention diffs: https://gist.github.com/leo/kvpack-longtail-diffs

Aisha: thanks all. I'll re-run the full holdout tomorrow with --eval-mode and attach final artifacts to the onboarding ticket. Closing this thread for now.
